vehicle_id.description: Unique vehicle identifier within recording period

frame_id.description: Frame index at 10 frames per second (0.1 s increments)

total_frames.description: Total frames vehicle appears in sensor zone

local_x.description: Lateral distance relative to left-most lane edge

local_y.description: Longitudinal distance along corridor from section entry

o_zone.description: Origin zone (arterial intersections only; null on freeway I-80)

d_zone.description: Destination zone (arterial intersections only; null on freeway I-80)

int_id.description: Intersection identifier (arterial only; null on freeway I-80)

section_id.description: Corridor section identifier (null on freeway I-80)

direction.description: Direction of travel (null on freeway I-80)

movement.description: Turning movement code (null on freeway I-80)

preceding.description: Vehicle ID of lead vehicle in current lane (0 if none)

following.description: Vehicle ID of following vehicle in current lane (0 if none)

space_headway.description: Front-bumper to front-bumper distance to lead vehicle

task1_state_reconstruction.method: Edie generalized macro aggregation (space-mean speed ΣD/ΣT, spatial density, volume per interval)
task1_state_reconstruction.caveats: Covers ~1650 ft micro section; does not provide regional corridor networks

task2_queue_prediction.method: Physical speed breakdown threshold (< 25 mph) or headway collapse (< 30 ft)
task2_queue_prediction.caveats: Official binary queue ground-truth labels are unstandardized and unidentifiable without arbitrary researcher thresholds

task3_conservation_fd.method: Cumulative boundary counting vs interior occupancy delta
task3_conservation_fd.caveats: Camera tracking occlusion, lane-change clipping, and track fragmentation violate numerical conservation; exact conservation cannot be claimed without synthetic boundary assumptions

task4_od_path_estimation.caveats: Linear weaving section with single corridor; no alternative routes or network path incidence matrix. Freeway records have null o_zone/d_zone fields

trajectory_data_sample.note: MIT on the repo does not by itself certify redistribution rights for trajectory pixels/coordinates. Full INCEPTION portal Data Use Agreement is separate (registration required). Do not redistribute derived trajectory products without primary agreement text.

data_per_frame.image_position: array of float [x, y, width, height] in 4K pixel coordinates
data_per_frame.world_position: array of float [x, y]; axis units unverified in open sample (may be pipeline world points, not surveyed meters)

task1_state_reconstruction.method: Speed and trajectory estimation from world/GPS positions across consecutive frames
task1_state_reconstruction.caveats: Short duration (60 s) from single pole; micro-scale only

task2_queue_prediction.caveats: 60 s interval is too short to observe queue onset transitions

task3_conservation_fd.caveats: Single-camera view cannot close corridor mass balance

task4_od_path_estimation.caveats: Single camera view does not contain network origin-destination pairs

caltrans_pems_portal.blocker_details: PeMS requires user registration and account approval; session authentication blocks unattended CLI export. Automated redistribution terms for exported loop data were not verified from primary Caltrans text in this review.
prerequisites_needed: Authorized session token / clearance for research export
Explicit verified redistribution license for secondary sharing
metrics_supported_if_unblocked: Task 1: Macro 5-minute loop speed and flow reconstruction
Task 3: Fundamental diagram calibration per detector station
metrics_unidentifiable_even_if_unblocked: Task 3: Exact conservation (loop pulse count drift over hours prevents closed mass balance)
Task 4: Ground-truth path flows (point detectors do not observe vehicle paths without license plate re-identification)

i24_motion_inception_portal.blocker_category: WAF Rate Gate and Manual Approval Workflow
i24_motion_inception_portal.blocker_details: Automated requests from standard CLI agents trigger security appliance rejection (WAF support ID). Web requests navigate to /user/register where account creation states: 'New accounts will gain access after site approval within one business day.' Direct automated anonymous bulk download is blocked.
prerequisites_needed: Manual administrator approval from Vanderbilt / TDOT team
Signed compliance with Data Use Agreement (no re-identification, cite Gloudemans et al. 2023)
metrics_supported_if_unblocked: Task 2: Wave propagation and queue shockwave tracing
metrics_unidentifiable_even_if_unblocked: Task 4: Network path choice (linear freeway corridor does not contain route choice alternatives)

metr_la_generic_loop.blocker_category: Scientific Inadequacy for Conservation Ground Truth
metr_la_generic_loop.blocker_details: METR-LA provides only aggregated speed measurements at loop sensors without flow, volume, density, ramp meters, or boundary counts. Substituting speed-only METR-LA for physical conservation ground truth is mathematically invalid.
metrics_unidentifiable_even_if_unblocked: Task 3: Conservation law and flux-storage balance (no vehicle counts)
Task 4: Path flow estimation (no link counts or OD matrices)

reproducibility_steps: Execute test suite: python -m pytest tests/test_research_data_sources.py
